newsitem.title: USA: Gaming industry may see consolidation - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Gaming industry may see consolidation - Barron's.

text.p: The gaming industry, afflicted by dwindling business and price wars, could see some industry consolidation in the future, according to the Review & Preview column in the November 25 issue of Barron's.
The paper said that a possible consolidation will favor the largest capitalized companies, particularly those with substantial Las Vegas properties.
These include Mirage Resorts Inc, Hilton Hotels Corp, ITT Corp, Circus Circus Enterprises Inc and MGM Grand Inc.
Also worth watching will be the aftermath of the New York, New York casino opening on January 3, the paper said.
MGM and Primadonna Resorts Inc, partners in the venture, each have the option of placing a bid for the other's stake six months after the opening.
The other party has 90 days to accept the offer or buy out its partner.
